subject: Proposal: Reliability commitment & premium support credits for BrightCart pilot
messages:
From: Emily Harper <emily.harper@brightcart.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot requirements + question on uptime credits and premium support pricing

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the model routing controls. We're scoping a 3-month pilot (North America traffic only) and need clarity on two items before we finalize internal approval:

1) Uptime / availability tiers — can you confirm the difference in crediting between 99.9% and 99.99%? We need a clear SLA credit formula we can share with Procurement.

2) Premium support/package pricing — specifically: response windows, escalation coverage (on-call weekends?), and whether you can offer an introductory discount for the pilot. BrightCart's procurement target is to keep early costs low while we validate reliability.

If you can send a concise package with pricing and suggested contract language (SOW + a simple credit table) we'd appreciate it. Would like to loop Legal if there are any non-standard clauses.

Best,
Emily Harper
Head of Integrations
BrightCart, Inc.

[Attachment: BrightCart_RFP_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Harper <emily.harper@brightcart.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot requirements + question on uptime credits and premium support pricing

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and great to hear the demo landed well. I've outlined a concise package below and attached the pricing PDF + draft SOW for your team to review. Happy to hop on a call to walk through details.

Summary (pilot: 3 months, NA):
- Availability tiers: 99.9% (standard) vs 99.99% (premium).
  - 99.9%: credit = 5% of monthly invoice for each 0.1% below target, capped at 50% of monthly invoice.
  - 99.99%: credit = 10% of monthly invoice for each 0.01% below target, capped at 100% of monthly invoice.
  - Notes: credits are applied pro-rata to the monthly service fee; token usage charges are excluded unless the outage prevents generation entirely.

- Premium support (option):
  - P1 (service down / major impact): 1-hour SLA response, dedicated phone escalation.
  - P2 (severe degradation): 4-hour SLA response, priority engineer triage.
  - P3 (functional issue, workarounds available): next-business-day response.
  - Escalation coverage: standard includes business-hours on-call; weekend on-call is available as an add-on (+$3,000/mo during pilot) — covers 24/7 paging to an on-call rotations team and named escalation contacts.

- Pricing & pilot discount:
  - Base hosted inference + standard support: quoted in attachment (month-to-month).
  - Premium SLA add-on: $12,000/mo (list) for the pilot workload size you described.
  - Pilot concession: 30% off premium SLA for the first 3 months if you commit to the 3-month pilot and provide a short scope doc (we can tie to the SOW).

- Operational notes:
  - We can enable prefix/KV caching for your traffic pattern to reduce token spend by an estimated 12–18% (we'll monitor).
  - We'll provide a runbook template and integrate a lightweight incident webhook into your ops channel.

Attachments: Redwood_Pilot_Pricing_v2.pdf, SOW_BrightCart_Draft.docx

Next steps:
1) Review attachments and share any legal redlines.
2) If acceptable, we can provision the pilot environment within 7 business days after contract signature.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call Thu/Fri to finalize.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: Redwood_Pilot_Pricing_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot requirements + question on uptime credits and premium support pricing

Team — forwarding BrightCart's request (below). They want weekend escalation coverage and asked if we can provide an introductory discount for the 3-month pilot. My proposed aperture: approve up to 35% off premium SLA for the pilot (we already suggested 30%), but we'd need to:

- Preserve the credit caps in the 99.99% tier (no exceptions).
- Require a short SOW and committed pilot scope.
- Charge the weekend on-call add-on at list (+$3k/mo) or absorb 50% for first month only (to reduce friction).

Impact: if we go to 35% on premium SLA, margin impact is ~8 pts over pilot. If we absorb 50% of weekend first month, incremental cost is ~ $1.5k.

Asks:
- Marissa: can we stretch to 35% (yes/no)?
- Vivek: legal/ops risk on weekend on-call + absorbing 50% first month?
- Tessa: confirm runbook/resource availability for weekend paging if we include it.

I want to keep this tight — BrightCart looks like they could scale quickly if pilot goes well.

Priya

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot requirements + question on uptime credits and premium support pricing

Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear credit table. A few clarifying points from Procurement/Legal: 

1) Weekend escalation: BrightCart needs weekend on-call as part of the pilot (we want to validate 24/7 coverage). Our preference is included in the pilot concession rather than an add-on.
2) Discount ask: our procurement target is to get premium SLA at 50% off for the first 3 months to keep costs predictable while we validate reliability.
3) Legal redlines: I've attached a short list of redlines focused on the credit calculation and force majeure language — nothing deep but we'd like to see responses inline.

If you could confirm the weekend coverage and the discount it's easier for us to push to sign. We're available for a call tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Emily

[Attachment: BrightCart_Redlines.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Harper <emily.harper@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, BrightCart Legal <legal@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot requirements + question on uptime credits and premium support pricing

Emily — appreciate the specificity and the redlines. We can move quickly: 

- Weekend on-call: we will include weekend escalation during the pilot. Operational detail: named engineer paging with 24/7 coverage; we will provide a runbook and an on-call rota. To be explicit: weekend coverage is included for the 3-month pilot only, then it reverts to business-hours unless you convert to a full premium SLA.

- Discount: we can approve 35% off premium SLA for the first 3 months and absorb 50% of the weekend add-on cost for month one (effectively making the first month of weekend coverage a $1.5k contribution by Redwood). We cannot meet 50% off list for the premium SLA given current capacity constraints.

- Credit language: we'll accept the majority of your redlines but need to preserve the credit caps in the 99.99% tier (we cannot remove the cap). I've asked Vivek and Legal to mark the attached redlines with our responses — see inline.

If that is acceptable, propose a 30-min alignment call today at 1:00pm PT to finalize SOW + DocuSign flow. After signature we will provision environment within 5 business days and schedule the runbook walk-through.

Next steps:
1) Emily/Legal: confirm acceptance of 35% concession + weekend-first-month split.
2) BrightCart: sign SOW and return via DocuSign (we'll send link).
3) Redwood: schedule provisioning & runbook workshop.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
